{{Conjecture}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used '''pods''' to breach enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They could lock onto docking bays and deploy clamps before disgorging their complements, which included [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Missile Platform/Legends|AT-MPs]]. They were deployed during the [[Battle near the Itani Nebula]] and the [[Assault on Kamino]] against the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] and the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]].

The rogue clone [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] destroyed many of the pods during those battles.

==Behind the scenes==
The breaching pods appear in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
